source: apps/server/local_llm/benchmarks/serving/fingerprint.py after #127, from the profiles in profiles.json as the seed migration stores them
algorithm: sha1sum of: alias, then the nine lines (the shell's six, then model, extra and fit), each followed by a newline; truncated to the first 8 hex characters

invariants.why: An empty LLAMA_SPEC is treated as off, not as an empty flag list rendered differently.
LLAMA_REASONING is ignored unless the profile carries reasoning_effort in EXTRA; the line stays n/a.
main.sh:239-243 guard rail: an MoE-only flag must never reach a dense model.
The model is fingerprinted by its file's basename: moving the weights directory keeps the config_id.

distinct.why: Two quants served under one alias are different configurations.
The shell invariant model-path-not-fingerprinted pointed at another file; after #127 that is another configuration.
Free-form extra arguments reach llama-server, so they are part of the configuration.
